# Unparalleled design routing

Read `.agents/skills/unparalleled-ui/SKILL.md` for application work and `.agents/skills/unparalleled-website/SKILL.md` for public websites. Read supporting references only as needed. The complete skill and the user's current brief govern the work.

Use bespoke meaningful icons, distinctive readable type, product-derived colors, and honest human prose. No emoji decoration, bullet-point marketing inventories, generic sans defaults, stock palettes, genre/morphism recipes, buzzword slogans, or em-dash spam. No card grids, kanban lanes, or pill-shaped controls, and no generic SaaS color (indigo buttons, purple-blue gradients, cyan or emerald accents on slate) or neon unless the user asks. Preserve semantic lists, familiar control meanings, explicit user choices, and established brand requirements.

"Bespoke" and "handcrafted" mean precise, product-specific craft; only "handmade", "handwritten", or "hand-drawn" call for literal hand marks. A dimension the user names (2D, 3D, or both) is a constraint.

Website motion must explain product behavior through purposeful 2D/3D relationships, preserve native scroll, and offer keyboard, touch, reduced-motion, and static equivalents. Keep useful discreet imperfections and stop after concrete quality checks rather than endless cosmetic tuning.

A sufficient brief starts research and a concrete specimen. New surfaces/overhauls iterate one representative specimen with the user until explicit green light for full development, unless review was already waived or the direction approved. Alternatives are optional; there is no five-page quota. Public website recommendations lean experimental through a product-specific composition, interaction or narrative. Do not default to oversized type, fine rules, broad whitespace and neutral editorial prose spreads. Local fixes retain the approved identity and scope. Read each skill's craft foundation for the self-contained synthesis of Impeccable, Awwwards, and Taste. Premium means an authored product-specific composition, useful signature interaction, coherent assets and detail, and a complete working path. Use the reference-intentions notes as interpretation, not copied scenes or style recipes.

Look at what you build. Run each skill's screenshot loop (`references/visual-review-loop.md`): use a connected Playwright tool or `node scripts/capture.mjs --install`, capture all viewports, open every image, fix one batch at the source, recapture, and compare until a round finds nothing consequential.

Repository checks: `npm run validate-all` and `npm run check-contrast`. Contrast fixtures do not certify a generated design; inspect real computed color pairs.

Use the complete skill's `references/anti-slop-invariants.md` and `references/visual-review-loop.md` for palette/gradients, type, spacing, shapes, icons, truthful copy, focus and meaningful motion. Maintain a severity/evidence/remedy/retest ledger and compare against the approved specimen; automated flags and scores do not supply user approval or waive hard failures.
